news.body:
## The tuition and the loan have stopped lining up
- The sanction is now dated five days after the payment.
Yesterday the SBI task moved to 10 November, because the documents have to be signed at your Indian branch and you only land on the 7th. The 53,000 euro instalment falls on the 5th. INSEAD already moved that date once at your request when the loan was slow, so the question is whether you pay it from your own funds or ask them again - and asking is easier three weeks out than three days out.

## Campus France put the sequence in writing
- Jakarta transfers only after Delhi says yes.
Fitria answered yesterday that she will move the dossier once Campus France New Delhi confirms they will take it, and she wants to be copied on your email to them. That makes Friday's TLS date on the board a date nothing will happen on, and your flight on 7 November the one that counts.
